subject.title: Add an FxTwitter read transport for public lookups, threads, profiles, and search

question: Should Birdclaw expand the accepted FxTwitter integration beyond explicit single-tweet import, and if so which one public read surface should be the next bounded phase?
rationale: The remaining requested surfaces change the third-party disclosure and data-ingestion boundary; source inspection confirms they are not already implemented, while the owner intentionally deferred them from the merged first phase.

options.title: Keep as phased tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a separate owner-approved scope for each next public read surface, beginning only when its privacy and capability boundary is specified.

options.title: Approve one next surface
options.body: Authorize one narrow follow-up such as public thread import or public profile lookup with fixed-origin and explicit-opt-in safeguards.

options.title: Close after phase one
options.body: Treat the completed single-tweet import as the final intended scope and close the broader request rather than adding general public reads.

recommendation.title: Keep as phased tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a separate owner-approved scope for each next public read surface, beginning only when its privacy and capability boundary is specified.

likelyOwner.reason: They set the accepted first-phase scope and authored the merged implementation that establishes the current boundary.
